explanation: Change 21 published duties using the existing fleet. Selected by independent planning demand; all ten hard-constraint categories pass. Held-out evaluation is shown separately.
tradeoffs: Reassignments change driver duties and may consume reserve fleet capacity.
Timetable shifts may increase waits at individual stops; aggregate gains are not guaranteed on the held-out day.
CP-SAT solves assignments for each fixed timetable; the whole transport plan is not proven globally optimal.

eta_evaluation.assumptions: Route projection; 70% historical segment prior + 30% smoothed observed speed; fixed 27-second dwell. Empirical residual interval from four independent synthetic days, target 80%; coverage is measured, not guaranteed.

demand_evaluation.assumptions: 12 independent synthetic weekdays; empirical 10–90% demand range. Risk: >100% high, >80% medium. Seats estimated after upstream boarding; interval totals do not guarantee connection timing.
